QUY-QV.identity: Reproduction of Genaro Rodrigo Quintero Bendezu, Vocabulario Basico, Huanta cover 2008 / credits 2003; same source previously independently accepted for draft and Share.
QUY-QV.new_binding: Computer-tagged restoration verb yapamanta allichay and recovery verb kutirichimuy. Prior draft noun ñawpa qillqasqa. General ñawpaq-kaq means predecessor; own ñawpaq yupa means previous number. No claim that proposed full phrases appear in the work.
QUY-QV.limits: One mirrored work, not two independent attestations from its two alphabetical directions. No original scan acquired. Date inconsistency unresolved. Comp marker is imperfect; both computer and ordinary senses are examined, not wholesale glossary approval. Same authors overlap own MINEDU Chanka dictionary, not independent speaker-lineage evidence.

QUY-MS.binding: Ayacucho software: p33 technical insufficient-memory frame; p34 Manam ... atikunchu inability construction; p38 waqaychay Save; p37 siqi image. Productive purpose -napaq supported p33. Existing approved results use -sqa, not a new automatic machine substitution.

QUY-ME.binding: Fresh read: ñawpaq temporal before contrasted with before/in front; kutiy return to former place; kichay opening and siqi drawing previously reviewed. Earlier accepted resultative -sqa noun/modifier pattern retained.

QUZ-AMLQ.binding: Fresh Cusco dictionary kutichiy means return/reintegrate/restitute; kutichina means to be recovered/returned (future/obligative), NOT already recovered. Completion in candidate comes from productive -sqa plus own software saved-state context, not the kutichina gloss.

QUH-LAIME.binding: Fresh multihead kutichiy,kutirichiy has cause-to-return sense; kutichiy,qupuy,kutichipuy has restitutive sense. Software restoration use independently in own PO.

QZ-AMLQ.binding: Fresh own entries ñawpa=previous/anterior; yapamanta=again; tatichiy=interrupt continuation; kutichiy=return/reintegrate/restitute. Existing approved Save result -sqa retained.

QH-LAIME.binding: Own tatichiy explicitly interrupt an action / suspend motion. Resultative -sqa composition marks interrupted/paused, not canceled or deleted. Not the unrelated physical standing-only sense of sayachiy.

QZ-WC-PO.binding: Own nonfuzzy inability Mana ... -ta atikunchu, saved-state revert kutichiy, memory-purpose -napaq mana aswan memoria kanchu. Existing approved Waqaychay unchanged. Copied-document context Kikinchasqa qhilqa-khiputa kichay and Copies Kikinchasqas support copy noun. Own Copy Text Box possessed object -n + -ta supports kikinchasqanta. QZ-WC-AMLQ.binding: Own ñawpa previous/anterior; yapamanta again; kutichiy return/reintegrate/restitute; llank'ay work/labor/task/occupation. WC-QH-HS.identity: Herrero/Sanchez, Estructura semantica del quechua cochabambino contemporaneo,1983
WC-QH-HS.binding: Own llank'ay sense4 work/action of working and own possessive examples work-of-Pedro, my/your work. Sense2 urban/general work is explicitly distinguished from sense1 farming; functional editor work follows nonagricultural sense, not claimed unmarked rural term. Own ñawpaqe grammatical explanation says genitive after consonant can be pa/paj versus j after vowel, supporting llank'aypa. No neighboring-variety work noun imported.

WC-QH-LAIME.binding: Own ñawpaq includes anterior/previous as well as front/first; context previous saved copy supplies temporal sense. This intentionally differs from QUZ ñawpa. Own manaraq = not yet, and restitutive kutichiy multiheads; accepted resultative -sqa preserved.

WC-QH-CENAQ.binding: Own Bolivian compilation separately labels -pa genitive and -n third-person possessive (CHU-source-marked, not exclusive Cochabamba). Corroboration of productive possessed-copy phrase, not its sole grammar source; PDF2015 metadata not falsely labeled2018.

RE-QZ-PO.binding: Fresh connector lines9649–9653: nonfuzzy Export File = Jawaman khiputa apachiy. QUZ header explicitly Cusco-Collao. RE-QH-HS.binding: Fresh own Cochabamba Herrero dictionary: t’aqasqata means separately and according to an arrangement/plan, opposed to mixed together. Digital use is authored semantic composition.

RE-QH-LAIME.binding: Fresh own jawa = exterior/outside and apachiy = remit/send; prior kutichiy restitute, source prospective form not completed recovery. Purpose kutichinapaq labels a copy FOR recovery, not a successfully recovered copy.

RE-QZ-AMLQ.binding: Fresh own hawa = outside/exterior relative to inside; apachiy send/remit. Own t’aqa t’aqa is explicitly adverb separately/in isolation, example uses separated groups of llamas; transfer to separate-file retention is proposed, not claimed published GUI usage. Prior ñawpa previous and kutichiy restitute. Not confusing sapa unique/alone or t’aqay cutting into pieces.

RE-QZ-APL-SEP.binding: Final independent review verified PDF1733 / printed1637 SEPARADAMENTE, de manera no conjunta = sapalla (sapaq). Use bare sapaq as attested non-distributive adverb. Own AMLQ sapaq separated/distinct corroborates, but primary adverb sense controls. Original t’aqa t’aqa candidate retained only in v1, not accepted.

review_boundary: Six independent source/semantic reviews cover all thirty-five exact values.
